description: A fabrication that contradicts itself: matchType NONE paired with a non-null locale, a range, and a weight. LocaleMatchResult's constructor (LocaleMatchResult.java:107-108) rejects the matched-state combination, and because the supplier is a lambda the library invokes lazily, the rejection lands on the CALL rather than on instance construction -- which is what makes the ingress-bypass cases on this same fixture possible.
